title: Running Doom on Our Custom CPU and Going Viral
summary: A developer built a custom CPU architecture from scratch and successfully ported the classic Doom game to run on it, with the project gaining significant attention and going viral on social media and tech communities.
problem_solved: Demonstrates the practical capabilities and real-world applications of a custom-designed CPU processor by running a complex video game.
why_valuable: Provides hands-on proof of concept for custom hardware design and serves as an engaging educational resource for understanding CPU architecture through a familiar, recognizable application.
